T0579.title: Mobile App Repackaging
T0579.definition: Modification and redistribution of a mobile app package after decompilation, patching, and resigning.
T0579.description: Mobile app repackaging decompiles, modifies, resigns, and redistributes an app. Attackers can add ad fraud, credential theft, payment hijacking, or risk-control bypass logic. Controls focus on official-signature checks, runtime integrity detection, channel monitoring, and takedown of counterfeit packages.
T0579.usageExample: Assess Mobile App Repackaging related exposure and define the corresponding controls.

references.title: MASTG-TECH-0039: Repackaging & Re-Signing - OWASP Mobile Application Security
